Discovers all AUTOFIX-*.json under .zqk/autofix/ and processes each via the
standardized

pipeline (INGEST → NORMALIZE → COMMIT → FINALIZE) per
docs/architecture/data-pipeline-lifecycle.md.

Used by SCH-autofix-process-pending so autofix files don't build up; can be
triggered when

batches are submitted or run on a timer. Internal command (hidden from main
help).

  Process pending (scheduler or manual)
  zqk.test system auto-fix-process-pending
  With explicit project root
  zqk.test system auto-fix-process-pending --project-root /path/to/project

Usage:
  zqk.test system auto-fix-process-pending [flags]

Flags:
      --allow-degraded        Allow running when scheduler daemon is not running (results may be partial/stale)
      --project-root string   Project root (default: resolve from current directory)
      --sync-glossary         After processing batches, run system sync-glossary-from-specs (dry-run report; organele maintenance)
      --sync-glossary-apply   With --sync-glossary, also create missing glossary terms (guarded by AUTOFIX_GLOSSARY_MAX_CREATE; requires explicit enable)
